offer.text: I took a bad turn out there, my heart, and I'm hurting more than I'll admit. Press a golden carrot into my hand and stay with me till the ache fades?

accept.text: Your touch already makes it better. Come here.

decline.text: ...It's fine. I'll mend on my own, as ever.

in_progress.text: Still smarting, love. That golden carrot would help.

ready.text: Oh, that's the stuff — the warmth is already spreading.

complete.text: Right as rain, and all because you fussed over me. My darling healer.
